announcements.headline: AGM Trading Statement and Brewery Strategy Update
Shepherd Neame - Notice of Annual General Meeting
Final results for the 52 weeks to 27 June 2026
announcements.insight: As the UK's oldest brewer with a unique tied estate model, Shepherd Neame's results are a critical barometer for the premium pub sector's resilience against cost-of-living pressures and shifting consumer habits. The outcome will signal whether the company can maintain margin stability amidst rising input costs and potential regulatory changes affecting the tied house system.
